description: This Java class implements a Liquibase custom change that disables all database triggers for all tables in the current schema. It connects to the database, retrieves table metadata, and executes 'ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE TRIGGER ALL' for each table.

classes.name: DisableTriggersChangeSet
classes.description: A custom Liquibase change implementation to disable triggers on all tables in the current database schema.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the operation of disabling all triggers for all tables in the current schema.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message indicating completion of the trigger disabling process.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets the resource accessor, currently empty.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the database configuration, returning an empty ValidationErrors object.
